verdict.rationale: Crossplane's state is defined as declarative YAML Kubernetes resources that are described as machine-readable and easy to commit to source control. It also offers portable Configuration packages and multi-language function configs. Together these imply your definitions sit in open formats and can be taken elsewhere, though nothing documents an actual export or exit path. Missing for 10: an explicit documented export/migration workflow, evidence covering export of runtime state and managed-resource data, and independent hands-on confirmation of leaving the platform.
